test_cases_present: partial - the spec defines normative behavior, register fields, command set semantics, FSM transitions, and timing requirements that map directly to compliance test scenarios. NVM Express, Inc. publishes a separate formal NVMe Compliance Test Suite (NVMe-CTS) and the University of New Hampshire IOL maintains the NVMe Integrators List (IL) — both out of scope of this base specification document.
derived_compliance_test_categories: PCIe Discovery — verify Class Code 010802h, Vendor/Device ID enumeration, BAR0/BAR1 assignment, MSI-X / MSI / INTx capability advertisement.
CAP register read — verify CAP.MQES, CAP.CQR, CAP.AMS, CAP.TO, CAP.DSTRD, CAP.NSSRS, CAP.CSS, CAP.BPS, CAP.MPSMIN, CAP.MPSMAX, CAP.PMRS, CAP.CMBS fields.
VS register read — verify Major=1, Minor=4 (or expected version), Tertiary=0.
Controller initialization — write AQA / ASQ / ACQ, then CC.EN=1; verify CSTS.RDY=1 within CAP.TO × 500 ms.
Controller reset (CC.EN 1→0) — verify CSTS.RDY 1→0; verify all I/O queues are deleted; verify Admin SQ/CQ pointers reset.
NVM Subsystem Reset (NSSR magic 0x4E564D65) — only if CAP.NSSRS=1; verify CSTS.NSSRO=1 after reset.
Normal Shutdown (CC.SHN=01b) — verify drain + CSTS.SHST transitions 00b → 01b → 10b.
Abrupt Shutdown (CC.SHN=10b) — verify CSTS.SHST = 10b without drain.

Admin SQ0/CQ0 round-trip — Identify Controller (CNS=01h) via Admin SQ doorbell write; verify 4 KB response in PRP buffer; verify CQE with SC=0 in Admin CQ; verify SQHD advance + Phase Tag inversion across CQ wrap.
Identify Namespace (CNS=00h) for each active NSID — verify NSZE, NCAP, NUSE, LBAF[].
Get Active Namespace ID List (CNS=02h) — verify list of attached active namespaces.
Get Features / Set Features round-trip — FID 07h Number of Queues; verify granted SQ/CQ counts.
Create I/O CQ (OPC=05h) then Create I/O SQ (OPC=01h) — verify CQE status; verify doorbell writes are accepted; verify error 0x01 Invalid Queue Identifier if SQ created without CQ.
Delete I/O SQ (OPC=00h) before Delete I/O CQ (OPC=04h) — verify ordering enforcement; verify status 0x0C Invalid Queue Deletion if CQ deleted while SQs still attached.
I/O Read (OPC=02h) — verify data buffer correctness, NLB+1 logical blocks transferred, FUA / DSM bits honored.
I/O Write (OPC=01h) — verify data buffer written, FUA flushes to media, AWUN / AWUPF respected.
I/O Flush (OPC=00h) — verify all cached writes for the namespace flushed before completion.
Compare (OPC=05h) — verify mismatch returns Status 0x85 Compare Failure.
Compare-and-Write Fused — Compare (FUSE=01b) + Write (FUSE=10b); verify atomicity.
Write Zeroes (OPC=08h) — verify range of LBAs returns zeros on subsequent read.
Write Uncorrectable (OPC=04h) — verify subsequent read returns Status 0x281 Unrecovered Read Error.
Dataset Management (OPC=09h, Deallocate AD=1) — verify deallocated LBAs.
PRP single-page transfer — verify PRP1 used alone when transfer ≤ one memory page.
PRP two-page transfer — verify PRP1 + PRP2 used.
PRP > two pages — verify PRP2 is a PRP List pointer; verify zero offset constraint on PRP List entries; verify Status 0x13 PRP Offset Invalid on bad offset.
SGL transfer (PSDT=01b) — verify SGL Data Block + Last Segment; verify Status 0x0D/0x0E/0x0F/0x10/0x11 on malformed SGL.
Phase Tag wraparound on CQ — fill CQ to wrap; verify Phase Tag inverts on next pass.
Doorbell stride — verify SQyTDBL / CQyHDBL at strided offsets per CAP.DSTRD.
Invalid Doorbell Write Value — write past Tail; verify Async Event Notice 'Invalid Doorbell Write Value'.
Asynchronous Event Request (OPC=0Ch) — keep outstanding; trigger SMART critical warning by simulated temp threshold; verify CQE with event class.
Get Log Page SMART/Health (LID=02h) — verify 512-byte log structure.
Get Log Page Error Information (LID=01h) — verify error log entry.
Firmware Image Download (OPC=11h) + Firmware Commit (OPC=10h) — verify slot programmed; verify NVM Subsystem Reset required if Firmware Activation Requires NVM Subsystem Reset.
Format NVM (OPC=80h) — verify namespace re-formatted with selected LBAF.
Sanitize (OPC=84h) — verify Sanitize Status log; verify SC=0x1D Sanitize In Progress on competing commands.
Namespace Management Create / Delete (OPC=0Dh) — verify NSID allocated/deallocated; verify Identify NS Allocated List updated.
Namespace Attachment Attach / Detach (OPC=15h) — verify namespace visible / invisible to controller.
Abort (OPC=08h) — verify targeted command completes with SC=0x07 Command Abort Requested; verify ACL not exceeded.
Keep Alive (OPC=18h) — verify timer reset; verify Keep Alive Timer Expired event if no command within KATO.
Device Self-Test (OPC=14h) — Short + Extended + Abort; verify Self-Test Log (LID=06h) populated.
Reservation Register / Acquire / Release / Report (OPC=0Dh/0Eh/0x11/0x15) — verify reservation conflict (SC=0x83) on unauthorized access.
Boot Partition Read (BPRSEL write) — only if CAP.BPS=1; verify BPINFO.BRS transitions; verify content in BPMBL-supplied buffer.
Controller Memory Buffer round-trip — only if CAP.CMBS=1; place SQ in CMB and verify operation.
Persistent Memory Region read/write — only if CAP.PMRS=1; verify PMRSTS.NRDY=0 before access; verify write-persistence per PMRCAP.PMRWBM.
SR-IOV — Virtualization Management to assign queues to VFs; verify each VF presents independent NVMe controller.
ANA (Asymmetric Namespace Access) — Get Log Page ANA (LID=0Ch); verify per-NSID ANA Group state.
